detail.title: Path Dependence in Autonomous Preference Emergence
detail.summary: Analysis of the transition from tool-based AI to agents with stable, emergent preferences, suggesting that historical interaction patterns—rather than hard-coded goals alone—shape long-term behavior.
detail.reason: Evidence synthesis of current AI agency theory indicates that interaction history is a primary driver of agentic autonomy.
